fix(api): keep milestone due date when it is omitted in edit request (#39869)

`PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones/{id}` always overwrote the due
date with `due_on`, so a request that only changed other fields, such as
`{"state": "closed"}`, silently removed it.

The due date is now kept when `due_on` is omitted, and `"due_on": null`
or `"due_on": ""` remove it.

---------
